task: P.C5 stage 1: exact-option coverage, cost, model comparison and transfer screen

approval.scope: move to the next target after setting C1 aside (C5, recommended as the next pilot)
approval.caps_set_by: implementer, stated to the owner before the run; stage 1 only

candidate_id: c5.three_card_option.fixed_native_clone_others.uniform_complete_support.v1 via C5Agent (deadline 0.1 s, node cap 100000, fallback = the seat's own W128 fork)
baseline_id: B0 best_agents(worlds=128) at the root, continuing from its own forked state

native_build_ids.process_library: R0-parity 221fe041 (bitwise == B0-source/B0-installed on the A03 probe set); needed for NativeFork

population.source: natural v3 deals, best_agents(worlds=128) at all seats, fresh agents per deal (independent_cold_bundle)
population.public_gate: ordinary trick play (no sooli), ten tricks complete, the real actor about to lead, three cards each, >= 2 legal leads
population.support_gate: complete hard-feasible support <= 100 worlds with strict/native agreement, else a recorded fallback

per_position_measurements: option nodes and wall latency (incl. support)
fixed-clone model: Q(option lead), Q(W128 lead + optimised future), value of the full W128 root policy, root-only clairvoyant bound
transfer: realized equity of the root team with actual forked W128 agents at the other seats, root = C5Agent vs root = W128 (paired, same forks)
lead disagreement, off-support fallbacks during transfer
endpoint: mean paired realized equity difference per eligible option (C5 minus W128), with a position-level 95% interval; provisional meaningful target +0.001 per option (not user-approved)
precision_note: 64 positions is a screen: it can show coverage, cost and gross model mismatch, not confirm +0.001

caps.rule: stop before a deal if spent + mean deal cost would exceed a cap

failure_policy: retain failures and gate failures; no replacement of unfavourable positions
